name: wgu-pilot-gateway
description: WGU pilot bundle, gateway-routed variant — installs WGU's engineering guardrails (governance knowledge) PLUS the Jira and GitHub MCP tools pointed at the WGU Solo Agent Gateway. Tool traffic flows through one governed door (auth, policy, rate-limit, observability) instead of each client calling vendors directly. Demonstrates 'guides vs guarantees': guardrails guide the agent client-side; the gateway governs tool traffic server-side.
